spacing: at most one point per 250 m MODIS cell
sampling_frame: centre pixel a target crop in >=1 year and 3x3 window class-uniform; no confidence or purity cut
confidence_filter: none at storage time; sweep 50/60/70/80 at analysis
purity_threshold: none (purity_m250 stored per point-year; lagged covariate only)
hls_window: monthly median, full year 2016-01-01..latest, L30+S30, Fmask-cleared
modis: MOD13Q1 NDVI + SummaryQA stored; quality filter applied at analysis
